about: Champlain is a township in Prescott-Russell, Ontario, on the Ottawa River—not Champlain, Quebec, and not a city. It joins Vankleek Hill, L’Orignal, and surrounding countryside; Hawkesbury is a neighbouring separate town. Franco-Ontarian and Loyalist heritage share the river-lot landscape. About 9,000 people live in Champlain Township.
